title: SCE 1.3 - Detect Malicious CodeBuild Project Creation
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment that validates a detective control (EventBridge rule monitoring CloudTrail) can detect the creation of a malicious AWS CodeBuild project. The attack simulates an adversary creating a CodeBuild project designed for credential exfiltration (Attack Node 1.2). The detective probe verifies that the EventBridge rule captures the codebuild:CreateProject API call and forwards evidence to a CloudWatch Log Group.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Malicious CodeBuild project creation is detected by EventBridge rule via CloudTrail
